lines.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain, and He gives sleep to His beloved.
Children are a heritage from the LORD, and those born in one's youth are like arrows in a warrior's hand.
The man with a full quiver of children born in youth will not be shamed facing enemies at the temple.
Blessed are all who fear the LORD, and your sons will be like olive shoots sitting around your field.
May the LORD bless you from Zion so that you see the prosperity of Jerusalem and your children's children.
